raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have an appointment at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Judecătoria Sectorului 2"
  role time "tomorrow at 9:30 am"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be sick"
  role subject "the user's lawyer"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "be allowed to ask for postponement alone"
    role subject "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "must send a substitute from the law office"
    role subject "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end
